changes.text: Local events: logging time in Tempo from an event marks the occurrence done; the "logged" mark on cards of the main list, as on the day scale
Exchange: answer status of others' meetings — mark and label everywhere, lighter color until answered; Accept / Tentative / Decline from the meeting menu
Day scale: Exchange tasks — strips at today's reminder (drag moves it), chips above the scale dropped onto it set a reminder
Main window: shortcuts — Alt+1…4 modules, Ctrl+T day scale, Ctrl+. settings, Ctrl+R refresh, Ctrl+U check for updates
Exchange: a new task with a due date gets the same start date
Tempo: timer — start on an issue, stop to log it, tray line and dot, reminders when long or a meeting begins
Day scale: drag to move, drag an edge to resize own events, Tempo worklogs and organized meetings
Tempo: worklogs on the day scale and in the calendar window, meetings marked as logged
Jira: Tempo module — today's worklogs, log time from the tab, the tray or a meeting, favorite and recent issues
Settings: working day start and end, the default start of new time entries
